name: The Royal Hawaiian
insider_take: The "Pink Palace of the Pacific" stands as Waikiki's most iconic landmark, where Hawaiian royalty once strolled and Hollywood legends have retreated since 1927.
whats_special: Built on the former site of Queen Liliuokalani's summer palace, this coral-pink Art Deco masterpiece is the only hotel in Waikiki with its own private beach section. The 15-acre tropical garden oasis features rare coconut palms that predate the hotel, and the signature Malasada Bar serves Hawaii's beloved Portuguese donuts with exotic local flavors.
pro_tip: Book the Coconut Grove rooms for direct garden access and listen for the resort's famous peacocks at dawn—descendants of birds gifted by a Hawaiian princess decades ago.
dont_miss: The weekly Royal Grove Experience featuring traditional Hawaiian ceremonies at sunset, and Azure Restaurant's locally-sourced seafood with unobstructed Diamond Head views. The hotel's historic banyan tree courtyard hosts intimate luaus exclusive to guests.
pros: Iconic 'Pink Palace' with legendary status and rich Hawaiian history
Prime beachfront location on world-famous Waikiki Beach
Luxurious tropical gardens and elegant Polynesian-inspired architecture
Premium amenities including exclusive beach access and multiple dining venues
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime location
Busy Waikiki Beach area with high tourist activity
